Headline: "Jordan evacuating Aqaba airport due to 'credible threat,' US embassy says"

The US Embassy in Jordan issued an advisory stating that Jordan is "evacuating the King Hussein International Airport and seaport in the Red Sea resort town of Aqaba due to a specific and credible threat."

The embassy strongly advised American citizens to avoid both the airport and seaport, as well as military installations throughout Jordan.

Context: two US troops were killed during an Iranian attack on a US base in Jordan on Friday, with one soldier remaining unaccounted for. Aqaba is adjacent to the Israeli resort city of Eilat.
